title: Understanding Model Risk
text: Model risk is the sum of model variance and observational variance. Can you calculate the model risk for the new model using the given variances?

title: Model Variance and Observational Variance
text: Remember, when you add more features to a model, it can affect both the model variance and the observational variance. Think about how these changes might impact the overall model risk.

title: Calculate New Model Risk
text: Given the new model variance of $$15$$ and observational variance of $$2$$, what is the new model risk?

hintAnswer: Model variance may increase, but observational variance may decrease.
title: Impact of Adding Features
text: When features are added to a model, which of the following is likely to happen?
choices: Model variance may increase, but observational variance may decrease.
Both model variance and observational variance will increase.
Model variance will decrease, but observational variance will increase.
